responsibility: Defines the CRIS-specific RTL predicates used by the machine description to classify operators, operands, and address subexpressions during instruction matching. These predicates capture which operations are orthogonal or commutative on CRIS, recognize legal simple, BDAP, and BIAP addressing components, and identify special multiple-load/store parallels, giving cris.md reusable semantic tests that distinguish valid CRIS operand forms beyond generic GCC predicates.
